notes: Verifier K, wave 4. Printed Rewind: 'Counter target spell. Untap up to four lands.' Expectation from the text: 'target spell' is any single spell, so the opponent can answer a creature spell with Rewind and counter it (it goes to its owner's graveyard, never the battlefield); then Rewind's controller untaps at most four lands of their choice (plains1-plains4 untap, plains5 stays tapped). Rewind's {2}{U}{U} is paid from seat 1's four blue. Converted 2026-11-11 to real priority (docs/DESIGN_PRIORITY.md): the response window is gone, so the answer is a spell cast while the first waits on the stack ("hold").
